component.name: Needle
component.summary: A fast, careful player for the music you own

description.p: Needle plays the music on your computer: lossless, private, and yours to arrange.

ul.li: Synced lyrics, word by word, and a full screen player
Smart playlists built from rules, and playlists with covers
Themes, plugins, and your Navidrome or Subsonic server
Play on Chromecast, AirPlay, and DLNA speakers
